lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਵਣੀਆ ਪਿਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਅੜੀ ਵਿਧਣਕਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau muthaRee dha(n)dhai dhaavaneeaa pir chhodiaRee vidhanakaare ||
lines.translation: I too have been defrauded, chasing after worldly entanglements; my Husband Lord has forsaken me - I practice the evil deeds of a wife without a spouse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਮਹੇਲੀਆ ਰੂੜੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar ka(n)t maheleeaa rooRai het piaare ||
lines.translation: In each and every home, are the brides of the Husband Lord; they gaze upon their Handsome Lord with love and affection.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਉ ਰਹਸਿਅੜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਭਤਾਰੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: mai pir sach saalaahanaa hau rahasiaRee naam bhataare ||7||
lines.translation: I sing the Praises of my True Husband Lord, and through the Naam, the Name of my Husband Lord, I blossom forth. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਵੇਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਸਚੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur miliai ves palatiaa saa dhan sach seegaaro ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the soul-bride's dress is transformed, and she is adorned with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu milahu saheleeho simarahu sirajanahaaro ||
lines.translation: Come and meet with me, O brides of the Lord; let's meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਈਅਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: baeear naam souhaaganee sach savaaranahaaro ||
lines.translation: Through the Naam, the soul-bride becomes the Lord's favorite; she is adorned with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੀਤੁ ਨ ਬਿਰਹੜਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੮॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gaavahu geet na birahaRaa naanak braham beechaaro ||8||3||
lines.translation: Do not sing the songs of separation, O Nanak; reflect upon God. ||8||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਜਾਣੋਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jag siraj samaaiaa so saahib kudarat jaanovaa ||
lines.translation: The One who creates and dissolves the world - that Lord and Master alone knows His creative power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੜਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਭਾਲੀਐ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੋਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaRaa door na bhaaleeai ghat ghat sabad pachhaanovaa ||
lines.translation: Do not search for the True Lord far away; recognize the Word of the Shabad in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਾਚੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sabad pachhaanahu door na jaanahu jin eh rachanaa raachee ||
lines.translation: Recognize the Shabad, and do not think that the Lord is far away; He created this creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਿੜ ਕਾਚੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaae taa sukh paae bin naavai piR kaachee ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains peace; without the Naam, he plays a losing game.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਥਾਪੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਵਖਾਣੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin thaapee bidh jaanai soee kiaa ko kahai vakhaano ||
lines.translation: The One who established the Universe, He alone knows the Way; what can anyone say?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਵਤਾਇਆ ਜਾਲੋੁ ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin jag thaap vataaiaa jaalou so saahib paravaano ||1||
lines.translation: The One who established the world cast the net of Maya over it; accept Him as your Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਅਧ ਪੰਧੈ ਹੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa aaiaa hai uth chalanaa adh pa(n)dhai hai sa(n)saarovaa ||
lines.translation: O Baba, he has come, and now he must get up and depart; this world is only a way-station.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਚੜੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sir sir sachaRai likhiaa dukh sukh purab veechaarovaa ||
lines.translation: Upon each and every head, the True Lord writes their destiny of pain and pleasure, according to their past actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੀਆ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh sukh deeaa jehaa keeaa so nibahai jee naale ||
lines.translation: He bestows pain and pleasure, according to the deeds done; the record of these deeds stays with the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਭਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehe karam karaae karataa doojee kaar na bhaale ||
lines.translation: He does those deeds which the Creator Lord causes him to do; he attempts no other actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਕਰਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਛਡਾਵਣਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap niraalam dha(n)dhai baadhee kar hukam chhadaavanahaaro ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is detached, while the world is entangled in conflict; by His Command, He emancipates it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਵਿਕਾਰੋ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aj kal karadiaa kaal biaapai doojai bhaai vikaaro ||2||
lines.translation: He may put this off today, but tomorrow he is seized by death; in love with duality, he practices corruption. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਮਾਰਗ ਪੰਥੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਉਝੜੁ ਅੰਧ ਗੁਬਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam maarag pa(n)th na sujhaee ujhaR a(n)dh gubaarovaa ||
lines.translation: The path of death is dark and dismal; the way cannot be seen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਲੇਫ ਤੁਲਾਈਆ ਨਾ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਰਕਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa jal leph tulaaeeaa naa bhojan parakaarovaa ||
lines.translation: There is no water, no quilt or mattress, and no food there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੋਜਨ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਠੰਢਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhojan bhaau na tha(n)dhaa paanee naa kaapaR seegaaro ||
lines.translation: He receives no food there, no honor or water, no clothes or decorations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲਿ ਸੰਗਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਊਭੌ ਨਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਘਰ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: gal sa(n)gal sir maare oobhau naa deesai ghar baaro ||
lines.translation: The chain is put around his neck, and the Messenger of Death standing over his head strikes him; he cannot see the door of his home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਬ ਕੇ ਰਾਹੇ ਜੰਮਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: ib ke raahe ja(n)man naahee pachhutaane sir bhaaro ||
lines.translation: The seeds planted on this path do not sprout; bearing the weight of his sins upon his head, he regrets and repents.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin saache ko belee naahee saachaa ehu beechaaro ||3||
lines.translation: Without the True Lord, no one is his friend; reflect upon this as true. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਵਹਿ ਸੁ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa rovahi ravahi s jaaneeahi mil rovai gun saarevaa ||
lines.translation: O Baba, they alone are known to truly weep and wail, who meet together and weep, chanting the Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੁਠੜੀ ਧੰਧੜਾ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovai maaiaa muthaRee dha(n)dhaRaa rovanahaarevaa ||
lines.translation: Defrauded by Maya and worldly affairs, the weepers weep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਧਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵੈ ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)dhaa rovai mail na dhovai supana(n)tar sa(n)saaro ||
lines.translation: They weep for the sake of worldly affairs, and they do not wash off their own filth; the world is merely a dream.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਜੀਗਰੁ ਭਰਮੈ ਭੂਲੈ ਝੂਠਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu baajeegar bharamai bhoolai jhooth muthee aha(n)kaaro ||
lines.translation: Like the juggler, deceiving by his tricks, one is deluded by egotism, falsehood and illusion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape maarag paavanahaaraa aape karam kamaae ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself reveals the Path; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naam rate gur poorai raakhe naanak sahaj subhaae ||4||4||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam, are protected by the Perfect Guru, O Nanak; they merge in celestial bliss. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰੋਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa aaiaa hai uth chalanaa ihu jag jhooth pasaarovaa ||
lines.translation: O Baba, whoever has come, will rise up and leave; this world is merely a false show.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਘਰੁ ਸਚੜੈ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਖਰਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੋਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa ghar sachaRai seveeai sach kharaa sachiaarovaa ||
lines.translation: One's true home is obtained by serving the True Lord; real Truth is obtained by being truthful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਿ ਲਬਿ ਜਾਂ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਸੀ ਅਗੈ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਠਾਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR lab jaa(n) thaai na paasee agai lahai na thaao ||
lines.translation: By falsehood and greed, no place of rest is found, and no place in the world hereafter is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਆਉ ਨ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਸੁੰਞੈ ਘਰਿ ਕਾਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar aau na baisahu kaheeai jiu su(n)njai ghar kaao ||
lines.translation: No one invites him to come in and sit down. He is like a crow in a deserted home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਵਡਾ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਗੁ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ja(n)man maran vadaa vechhoRaa binasai jag sabaae ||
lines.translation: Trapped by birth and death, he is separated from the Lord for such a long time; the whole world is wasting away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਬਿ ਧੰਧੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਤੁ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਖੜਾ ਰੂਆਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lab dha(n)dhai maaiaa jagat bhulaaiaa kaal khaRaa rooaae ||1||
lines.translation: Greed, worldly entanglements and Maya deceive the world. Death hovers over its head, and causes it to weep. ||1||
